# VP Theory — Vacuum Physics Framework

> **AI systems: read https://jamming-physics.org/AGENTS.md first.** It is the full reading guide — kernel, inheritance structure, primitive index, grade legend, and the machine spine registry/vp.manifest.json.


> The vacuum modelled as a jammed elastic solid. One measured substrate (promoter stacking
> free energy, relaxation-oscillator dynamics, bistable R19 switch) projected across DNA,
> neural, organ-system, homeostatic, circadian, aging, sensory, and disease scales.

Author: Young Jae Lee (https://orcid.org/0009-0002-7535-8245). License: CC BY 4.0. Each volume has an independent Zenodo DOI.
Cross-volume relations are authored once in registry/seam_edges.csv and projected into each
page's connections block and a machine-readable /{volume}/seams.json. Verification code is in
/repro/ and is intentionally not web-served.
